text:
jordan: Heads-up: Lighthouse Med (acct LM-990) showing steady drop in daily active API keys, onboarding flagged as incomplete. Renewal in 12 days, flagged 'watchlist'.

rachel: How big is the account and who owns renewal?

jordan: $68k ARR, enterprise tier. Renewal owner is rene@lighthouse.com. Onboarding score 40/100, missed two enablement sessions.

omar: Any product issues? errors, latency, or billing disputes?

jordan: No billing issues. One support thread about embeddings alignment (SUP-445). Error rates low but usage for inference endpoints decreased ~55% past 10 days.

tina: We should avoid discount runway early. Propose: 1) targeted enablement workshop + success metrics, 2) pilot for optimized batching & prefix caching, 3) 30-day trial credits to restore traffic if they accept the workshop.

rene: I can make time but want a short plan I can send to my CTO. Can you draft a one-pager?

jordan: Drafted a quick plan below, pls review owners.

```
- outreach: owner jordan, within 24h. quick email + calendar poll to rene and engineering lead.
- workshop: 45m technical workshop + 15m exec check-in (owner: rachel). goal: fix prompt & endpoint regressions, identify top 3 token sinks.
- audit: run a prompt/usage audit and share 3 remediation recommendations (owner: omar).
- infra: provide a config bundle for batching, KV caching, and quantization best-fit (owner: tina).
- offer: 30d usage credits equal to ~10% of monthly spend contingent on completion of workshop and audit (owner: jordan).
- escalation: if no reply in 48h escalate to AM lead (owner: jordan -> tag csm_lead).
- timeline: aim to complete workshop and audit in 7 days to show impact before renewal.
```

omar: I'll pull top endpoints and token distribution. Quick query I'll run: 
```
SELECT endpoint, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM usage.events WHERE account='LM-990' AND ts>now()-14d GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 5;
```

rachel: I'll draft the 1-pager and attach to thread. Keep messaging tight for execs.

jordan: I'll send initial outreach now. If they accept, we propose Tue/Wed next week slots.

cse_bot: Account health snapshot added: https://redwood.app/account/LM-990/health | onboarding checkpoints, NPS 5, last enablement attended 40 days ago.

rene: Received the email. Can we do Tue 11am PT? CTO tip: they want to see latency improvements or reduced token bill.

tina: We'll bring a short demo: before/after batching + caching numbers and sample config diff. Also include a cost projection table.

omar: Posting preliminary audit notes by EOD: top token sink is a verbose system prompt and repeated metadata per call. Simple fix to dedupe metadata could lower tokens 20-30%.

jordan: Great. Actions assigned: outreach (jordan), workshop deck & exec summary (rachel), audit & token fixes (omar), batching bundle (tina). I'll update the account timeline with the save-play.

rene: Thanks team — appreciate proactive approach. If we see engagement spike after workshop, we'll move to renewal extension conversation.

jordan: Marking as high-touch save plan and tagging renewal as "conditional". I'll post the 1-pager shortly.

cse_bot: Save-plan artifact attached to account timeline. Reminder set: follow-up in 3 days if no workshop confirmation.
